target.title: Stream native reasoning events through agent subscriptions
target.body:
## Summary

- emit native reasoning streams to agent subscribers even when the channel has no onReasoningStream callback
- keep assistant event-bus streams live while before-terminal delivery gates still defer channel partial replies
- avoid streaming native reasoning placeholder text and handle cumulative text_delta payloads that omit delta

## Scope

This is a Core event semantics fix. It does not add or claim a provider/model support matrix; provider adapters still need to map each provider/model endpoint to native thinking_delta separately when required.

Refs openclaw/openclaw#5086 and extends the direction in openclaw/openclaw#87481 by also preserving assistant live streams under before_agent_finalize.

## Validation

- node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.before-terminal-delivery.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.subscribe-embedded-agent-session.subscribeembeddedagentsession.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-utils.test.ts
